text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Jordan bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter or hard red spring or optional origin wheat for October shipment at $178.80 per tonne on Tuesday, traders said. It was also extending until Thursday the deadline for offers of another 50,000 tonnes and bringing forward the shipment period to second half October from November.
- The CCC said it bought 24,181 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for donation to Eritrea.
CORN SALES - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) on Tuesday bought 77,000 tonnes of Chinese corn, traders said.
- A South Korean buyer group, known as the Big Feed Mills, has purchased 30,000 tonnes of Chinese corn at $124.65 a tonne, C&F, traders said on Tuesday.

CORN TENDER - South Africa's North-West Co-operative Ltd said it would offer for export 34,650 tonnes of yellow maize grade YM1 with an option to deliver up to 20 percent YM2 grade. Tenders closed on August 15.
WHEAT TENDERS - Jordanian traders said on Tuesday Iraq was expected to buy shortly about 100,000 tonnes of French wheat and 70,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

Paris-based grain traders said last week that Iraq had tendered to buy up to 100,000 tonnes of French wheat for shipment in September or October, and Jordanian traders said it could now be seeking another 70,000 tonnes from the U.S. The deadline for offers in the tender is Friday, August 15.
- The CCC saidas seeking on August 12 up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better soft white wheat for donation to Pakistan. Shipment period was slated for November 1-30.

WHEAT TENDERS - Morocco was negotiating late on Tuesday in a bid to import 90,000 tonnes of soft wheat in September, European grain traders said. The tender is for 90,000 tonnes of wheat for September 7-15 arrival.
- The CCC will tender on August 11 for 27,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for donation to Eritrea. The shipment is August 24-September 13.
BARLEY TENDER - Iran launched a tender for 50,000 tonnes of barley to be shipped in October, European grain traders said. The tender calls for offers to be submitted on Tuesday.
SOYBEAN TENDER - The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association will tender on Wednesday for two 56,000-tonne shipments of U.S. soybeans, traders said Tuesday.

VEGOIL TENDERS - El Salvador was seeking about 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,500 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 Title 1 export program, its U.S. export agent said. Both commodities were slated for October 1-15 shipment. Offers were due on August 14.

- Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries on August 19 will seek 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery. September 1 was set as the final date to receive bids. Results would be on September 8.
